 and harness

Transformer
 isolation and earthing on all its sides is required

There is a
 danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working near large power
 transformers.

A
 proper well fixed ladder should be used for climbing on top of the
 transformer tank.

Safety
 helmet, safety belt, and tool set

Voltage
 indicator, Ladder

Portable
 earth for discharging,

Fine
 cloth for cleaning purposes,
Silicagel,

Complete
 tool kit/set, including a torque wrench.

Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning. Collect it and send it to the dump.

Fix
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil
leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and
ground water and eventually on the ecosystem.
"It takes only I liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption

Check 
 for signs of oil leaks, correct if possible.

Inspect all painted surfaces of the
 transformer, remove any signs of rust and repaint bar spots.

Check condition of earthing bus, all bolted
 connections must be checked for tightness.

Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces on all
 bushings

Check for correct oil level kin all
 transformer bushings, top up if necessary

Open bleed valve on buchholz relay until a
 small amount of oil escapes, test alarm and trip circuit using the test
 button next to the vent valve, check all electrical connections for
 tightness
Check the breather, if required replace or regenerate the silica gel

Check the pressure relieve device on main
 transformer tank and if fitted on ULTC compartment

Inspect condition of all cooling fans, check
 that screens have no obstructions, check for cracks in fan blades, test run
 all fan motors and check for abnormal bearing noise. It is recommended to
 change motor bearings after 3000 hours of running time or every 4 years,
 whichever comes first. Interval may be adjusted by technical services Unit

Inspect transformer control cabinet, blow out
 dust, check condition of door seal, check all electrical connections for
 tightness, check proper operation of space heaters. Test operation of fan
 control, adjust temperature setting as necessary

Use
 water pressure to clean radiators and transformer
 tank walls, do not direct the stream of water directly at the cooling fans.
 It is recommended to use the transformer deluge system to perform the
 cleaning operation, it will provide a functioning test for the system at the
 same time. The unsealed wiring must cover by plastic covering to avoid s.c
 in wiring system.

Take and record insulation
 resistance readings (Megger readings), high voltage winding to low voltage
 winding, high voltage to tertiary to tertiary winding, low voltage to
 tertiary winding, high voltage to earth, low voltage to earth, tertiary
 winding to earth. Compare readings to historical data.

Take and record capacitance
 dissipation factor percentage tan %
 compare reading to historical data.

Perform ratio
 tests in lowest, highest and neutral tap position, compare each high voltage
 to neutral winding to corresponding low voltage to neutral winding. Compare
 readings to historical data readings taken at all pts of top changer.

Take
 and record winding resistance readings, each high voltage phase to neutral,
 each low voltage phase to neutral, tertiary delta winding phase to phase for
 all pts of tap changer. Compare readings to historical data.

Inspect
 and clean tap changer control cabinet, check all electrical connections for
 tightness, check functioning of cabinet heater and check door seals, check
 motor operating mechanism.

It
 is important to perform a complete tap changer operation from highest to
 lowest step and back to the position it was fund in, this action will clean
 all internal contacts of the tap changer

Inspect
 condition of external tap changer drive shaft, tighten all couplings and
 bolted connection

Take
 and record final reading on tap changer operations counter

Take
 oil samples for laboratory analysis, (see procedure T-SS-001-3) and gas
 analysis for main transformer and for OLTC

Be
 sure that all tools have been taken off the top of the transformer

Place
 transformer back into normal operating condition
